historical_record.description: Sold for $26,500, deed recorded July 9, 1969. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it as a comparable sale, described two-flat building (a six-room flat over a five-room flat) with an asbestos-shingle front and rustic sides, gabled roof, full basement with garage, terrazzo steps, built about 1895.
Redevelopment Agency inspectors recorded two flats, the exterior and interior both in good condition. Assessed at $1,350 for the land and $1,000 for the improvements.

The Redevelopment Agency photographed it as sample no. 16 of its 50-building study of whether Western Addition Area Two's housing could be conserved rather than cleared, listing it as a two-family building.
